purpose: Present deterministic selected-drive telemetry artwork alongside sampled evidence, channel coverage and interpretation limits.
primaryGoal: Select a historical drive, understand its observed emission fingerprint without mistaking it for a score or time-weighted analysis, and export the artwork or plotted evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-gated, bounded isolated history query, MODERATE staleTime, safeArray selection and AbortSignal forwarding. No page-local date picker or additional vehicle picker.
dataSources.limits: Backend response ordering, completeness, authorization and actual data were not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a drive ID; query key ['drive-telemetry', driveId]; safeArray selection; AbortSignal forwarded. Separate source trust from list metadata.
dataSources.limits: No backend implementation or network response inspected. Full-feed claims and the legacy power unit remain unverified.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace, unit, timezone and data-trust mechanisms
dataSources.behavior: Header owns vehicle scope; local selector chooses a drive, not a second workspace vehicle. /drive-dna is not in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:23-77); current scope is one selected drive from the capped history, not a global date window. Initial/fatal/refresh states are adapted independently.

Inspected ranges show stable timestamp sorting, invalid/duplicate accounting, missing channels, elapsed seconds, speed m/s, elevation metres and one power multiplication by 1000 at lines 809-817. Artwork cap 720 and chart cap 600; metrics describe emissions, not elapsed-time weighting.
dataSources.limits: Model read in selected ranges and symbol matches, not fully reviewed or mathematically tested. Multiplication assumes power is kW; the unannotated power field in web\src\types\driving.ts:63-69 does not independently establish that wire contract.

components.name: DriveDnaCadenceMetrics / DriveDnaSignalCoverageGrid
components.contract: Existing NestedDrivingBrief adapters: six cadence metrics and five channel counts with valid-row denominators; missing durations and percentages remain unknown.

components.contract: Escaped standalone SVG, sanitized signature filename, local Blob download, synchronous anchor cleanup and deferred URL revocation.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / mission section 4: avoid repeated presentation
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Two consecutive DriveDnaMethodologyCards mounts at lines 133-134 render the same two cards and all eight explanation bullets twice.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Render one instance while preserving every unique explanation, source limit and methodology status.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: A ChartContainer host at DriveDnaSpeedPowerChart.tsx:88 wraps an EmbeddedChart that delegates to another ChartContainer (EmbeddedChart.tsx:30). The same nesting occurs for SoC/elevation at DriveDnaSocElevationPlot.tsx:62 and both distributions at DriveDnaDistributionBarPlot.tsx:63. Timeline hosts and children share chart keys while independently receiving hiddenSeries; distribution children add a second fallback with fewer columns.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use plot-only feature renderers inside the existing host; pass host series visibility through. Retain host tables, share percentages, export filenames, fluid geometry and series persistence.

issues.detail: Fixed dual axis widths 64+68 and horizontal margins 18+28 consume 178px before the plot; both channels at 320px allocated page width risk a very narrow plotting area. Distribution axes similarly reserve 116/136px plus margins. This is a source risk, not observed overflow.
issues.fix: Validate small allocated widths and long translations using the existing responsive chart contract; adapt axis spacing/labels without hiding channels, tooltips, tables or exports.

responsive.status: All ten mission widths, RTL, 200% text and container overflow unverified.

sourceObserved: DriveDNAPage.tsx:153-162 labels the shared Select and disables an empty option list.
DriveDnaFingerprintPanel.tsx:60-65 supplies an image role and signature-bearing localized alternative; genome statistics and encoding legend expose textual evidence.
Four host ChartContainers provide localized accessible names and dataColumns; timeline plots explicitly omit their own table while hosts retain data alternatives.

accessibility.status: Keyboard, focus, screen-reader announcements, actual contrast, forced colors, touch target dimensions and reduced motion are unverified. Nested chart semantics are recorded once under duplicatedPatterns.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-015: theme-aware restrained surfaces
visualIssues.detail: Methodology cards use fixed-white translucent border/background at lines 12 and 46. Encoding cards repeat the same pattern in DriveDnaEncodingLegend.tsx:174, bypassing neutral theme-aware surfaces.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface and border tokens or existing card composition. Preserve the explanatory hierarchy and all encoding evidence, without introducing a new wrapper or palette.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-034 / mission sections 5 and 27: restrained palette with preservation
visualIssues.detail: Artwork saturation reaches 95%, with magnitude-dependent HSL color and an independently computed dark halo. This is a data-encoding palette, not mere chrome: the legend says pack power drives hue/stroke width. No measured contrast or rendered neon claim is made.
visualIssues.fix: Keep the existing deterministic encoding and safe export parity unless the integration owner establishes equivalent restrained colors. Reduce surrounding decoration first; never silently change signatures, traits, data dimensions or exported artwork.

architectureIssues.detail: Brief scope inserts raw drive.startTs and drive.endTs strings, while the selector and drive label use formatDateTime with the selected vehicle timezone at DriveDNAPage.tsx:85,94. The summary therefore bypasses the established display formatting policy.
architectureIssues.fix: Format both scope endpoints with existing dateFormat/timezone preferences while retaining ongoing-drive text and exact underlying timestamps. Do not alter query bounds or raw cache data.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045: establish wire-unit evidence before SI changes
architectureIssues.detail: The model and methodology explicitly assume a legacy kW power wire value and multiply by 1000. This conflicts with the general SI-wire target but is not proven to be incorrect for this endpoint; the frontend telemetry type has no power unit annotation.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must pin actual handler/StateReader power semantics and SI cutover before any unit change; retain existing arithmetic until evidence resolves it. Do not introduce a dual-shape adapter or cosmetic conversion change.

priority.rationale: Well-decomposed page already preserves independent evidence shells and modern summary adapters. Prioritize duplicated methodology and nested chart controllers; resolve unit-contract uncertainty before analytical changes. No runtime critical defect established.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse canonical single-owner chart composition; no shared API change currently established
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing data/dataColumns, exportable/exportFilename, chartKey, hiddenSeries render prop and fluid/embedded presentation cover the observed needs. Plot-only feature children should consume the host controller.
dependsOn: Preserve existing chart keys, host data alternatives, share columns and export capabilities

requiredSharedChanges.name: Telemetry wire power contract evidence
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: GET /drives/{driveID}/telemetry routes to driveHandler.TelemetryReadings; implementation ownership beyond that route was not inspected. Confirm raw power units, nullable values and completeness before SI integration changes.

competingImplementations.detail: Legacy KPI-band renderer exists beside mounted DriveDnaEvidenceBrief; the page uses the operational brief at DriveDNAPage.tsx:185, and the brief retains only a type dependency on DriveDnaKpiBand. Existence alone is not proof of another mounted implementation.
competingImplementations.disposition: Do not remount the old summary or remove it without caller evidence. No new stats system needed.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page and all 18 drive-dna TSX files, including unmounted legacy KPI band; excludes operationalbrief adapters and analytical model. No historical baseline comparison.

dataBehavior: Workspace vehicle ownership, capped history semantics and selected-drive-only telemetry

SI model values, current single legacy power lift pending backend proof, display-only preferences

Chart and art sampling limits, complete explanatory guardrails and all coverage/cadence metrics
Retained data survives refresh failures; all section shells remain reachable
